description: This file provides syntax analysis helper methods for Roslyn-based source code analysis within the Orleans project. It includes extension methods to work with attribute syntax, member declarations, class/interface inheritance checks, and extracting attribute arguments.

classes.name: AttributeArgumentBag<T>
classes.description: A generic record struct used to hold the value and location of an attribute argument.

classes.name: SyntaxHelpers
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for syntax analysis in Roslyn C# code.

methods.name: TryGetTypeName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the type name from an AttributeSyntax.

methods.name: IsAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an AttributeSyntax matches a given attribute name, considering naming conventions.

methods.name: HasAttribute
methods.description: Determines if a member declaration has a specific attribute.

methods.name: TryGetAttribute
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a specific attribute syntax from a member declaration.

methods.name: GetMemberNameOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the name of a member (property or field), or null if not applicable.

methods.name: IsAbstract
methods.description: Checks if a member has the 'abstract' modifier.

methods.name: IsStatic
methods.description: Checks if a member has the 'static' modifier.

methods.name: HasModifier
methods.description: Checks if a member declaration includes a specific modifier.

methods.name: IsInstanceMember
methods.description: Determines if a member is an instance member (not static or const).

methods.name: IsFieldOrAutoProperty
methods.description: Determines if a member is a field or auto-implemented property.

methods.name: ExtendsGrainInterface
methods.description: Checks if an interface extends the 'IAddressable' interface.

methods.name: InheritsGrainClass
methods.description: Checks if a class inherits from the 'Grain' base class.

methods.name: GetArgumentBag
methods.description: Extracts a typed argument value from an attribute using semantic model info.

methods.name: GetAttributeSyntaxes
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute syntaxes with a specific name from attribute lists.

methods.name: GetArgumentValue
methods.description: Retrieves the constant string value of the first argument of an attribute.
